thread:
Jordan P (Partnerships): Heads up — partner reported perf regression on CUDA 12.3 kernels affecting marketplace images. Need a quick alignment: pin plan, canary window, and hotfix cadence. Who can take point for vendor comms?

Alex H (Eng Runtime): I can lead the triage. Initial ask: can we get the exact driver + CUDA combo they hit and sample logs?

Vendor GPU Ops (vendor-bot): vendor report: affected SKUs: g4x/g5x-rt; driver 525.105 -> 525.120 suspected. Attached kernel logs: /s3/vendor/regressions/4923.tar.gz

Nidhi S (Marketplace): If this is real we should hold the GA image rollout for the EU region. Can we do a temporary pin in marketplace metadata?

Mike T (SI): Pinned images are fine but we need a rollback playbook for customer-managed nodes. Also flagging customers with reserved Dedicated capacity.

Shelly R (QA): Quick repro matrix: small seq len (<=128) good, long contexts (>=1024) see perf drop. I'll run deterministic perf runs on our nightly hardware pool. ETA 2h.

Alex H (Eng Runtime): Proposed immediate actions:
1) Create a canary lane pinned to driver 525.105 and another to 525.120
2) Run perf delta suite (shelly's matrix) across both lanes
3) If 525.120 fails, prepare hotfix candidate and vendor rollforward/rollback notes

Jordan P (Partnerships): Nidhi, can Marketplace pause new image promotions for the EU/gcp region while we validate?

Nidhi S (Marketplace): Yes — pausing promotion now. I'll also add a message to release notes and gate any auto-upgrades.

Vendor GPU Ops (vendor-bot): Vendor will repro and provide micro-benchmarks. ETA 3h. Will also check if ROCm binaries show similar variance.

Mike T (SI): For SI customers: recommend communications template. Jordan, can you draft a short customer note we can push to comms?

Jordan P (Partnerships): Will draft. Key points: what happened, scope (regions/SKUs/customers), mitigation (pin + canary), ETA for fix, who to contact.

Shelly R (QA): Perf runs queued. Initial numbers should land in #eng-runtime-canary in ~90m.

Alex H (Eng Runtime): Quick config snippet for marketplace pinning (for ops):
```yaml
image_policy:
  default:
    cuda_driver: 525.105
  overlays:
    - region: eu-west-1
      override_driver: 525.105
```
Use this for canary lanes.

Nidhi S (Marketplace): Got it. I'll apply the overlay to canary lanes and block GA roll for eu-west-1.

Jordan P (Partnerships): Action items: Alex triage + hotfix path; Shelly perf; Nidhi block promo + notify; Mike prep SI template; Vendor to repro. I'll consolidate comms after initial perf signal. :raised_hands:

Vendor GPU Ops (vendor-bot): Update: repro confirmed on our end, perf delta ~18% on long contexts. Collecting artifacts.

Alex H (Eng Runtime): OK — start building hotfix candidate (ci/job: runtime/hotfix/492345). If we have a kernel-level mitigation, we'll ship a microrelease and update marketplace pin.

Jordan P (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll post the customer note draft in 30m for review.

Shelly R (QA): Initial perf numbers posted to #eng-runtime-canary — dropping a link: https://internal.reports/perf/492345

Alex H (Eng Runtime): Saw the numbers — confirming +18%-22% token latency increase on 525.120. Proceeding with hotfix branch.

last message by Jordan P (Partnerships): Will coordinate announcement timing once hotfix CI passes. Keeping GA pause until we have a rollback or the fix.
